calls.statement:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS web_orders
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = '2025-12-01'

SELECT DATE(order_ts_utc) AS order_date, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) BETWEEN '2025-11-30' AND '2025-12-02'
GROUP BY DATE(order_ts_utc)
ORDER BY order_date

SELECT calendar_date, day_of_week, day_name
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_date = '2025-12-01'

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN order_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_timestamps,
  MIN(order_ts_utc) AS earliest_timestamp,
  MAX(order_ts_utc) AS latest_timestamp
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE DATE(order_ts_utc) = '2025-12-01'
